locator: Materials and Methods › Study Design, 1st paragraph; Demographic and Ayahuasca Drinking Variables, 2nd paragraph; Results, 1st paragraph; Table 3, first row
extracted: Of 10,836 respondents (online survey, 2017 to 2019, six languages), the 6,877 who had drunk ayahuasca with two or fewer groups were analysed; of 6,817 with a known last context, 3,553 (52.1%) last drank in an ayahuasca church (UDV, Santo Daime or Barquinha), 1,338 (19.6%) with one or more traditional shamans and 1,926 (28.3%) in other contexts.
By last context (church, traditional, other): living in Brazil 87.0%, 6.4%, 19.4%; any lifetime mental-health diagnosis 29.2%, 39.0%, 44.5%; years since the last drink 1.2, 1.6 and 1.2.

By last context (church, traditional, other): mean support-and-safety rating 3.9, 3.8, 3.4; preparation rating 3.1, 3.3, 3.0; religious hymns or sermons 90.0%, 25.3%, 26.0%; fasting offered 2.0%, 34.9%, 25.7%.

locator: Table 4 and Table 5, support and safety row; Results › Multivariate Models, 2nd and 5th paragraphs
extracted: Support and safety rating (1 to 4), adjusted B (SE): extreme fear or panic (0 to 10) −0.29 (0.07); integration difficulties −0.13 (0.05, p = 0.018); Kessler-10 (scored 10 to 50, a 40-point span) −0.62 (0.12); SF-12 mental component 1.5 (0.23). Editors' arithmetic: over the 3 points of the rating, K10 differs by 1.86.

locator: Table 4 and Table 5, preparation activities score row; Results › Multivariate Models, 3rd and 6th paragraphs
extracted: Preparation activities rating (1 to 4: a chance to discuss one's history, motivations or concerns before drinking; guidance before drinking on dealing with possible difficulties), adjusted B (SE): integration difficulties −0.14 (0.03); extreme fear −0.01 (0.04, p = 0.816); Kessler-10 −0.25 (0.07). Editors' arithmetic: over the 3 points of the rating, K10 differs by 0.75.
